records.title: PR #1400 — fixed-horizon forecast ledger with optional source registry
records.summary: Updated head 005b03e adds optional caller-supplied source_registry validation. If supplied, forecast source IDs and later outcome price-source IDs must be registered; otherwise records explicitly say NOT_CHECKED. CI 41185194437 passed 370 tests plus 8 subtests; gate 41185194439 passed. PR remains open, draft and unmerged.
records.methodology: Inspected exact head diff, CI job log, gate, compare main/branch and updated PR body.
records.limitations: Registry membership is not source-quality or independence validation. No model training, walk-forward, drift detection or concurrent-writer lock is implemented. Branch is 2 commits ahead and 1 behind main's merge base; GitHub reports mergeable.

records.title: Security Incident Update #2
records.summary: Binance stated it allocated more than $6.34B of company funds, with about $5B already held in affected token assets, approximately $1.34B still to acquire through market/OTC channels and about $3B frozen. It said the full Proof of Reserves results would be available by Nov 2. No XRP-specific replenishment allocation was disclosed.
records.methodology: Official Binance announcement search result and company statement cross-checked against CoinDesk reporting.
records.limitations: Company claims; not an independent audit. The public announcement page redirected in the browser view. No post-incident PoR result was located by the 08:37:58Z cutoff.

records.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets; reserve data shows
records.summary: CoinDesk's review says Binance 14 appeared in the October 1 Proof of Reserves and reports the next reserve snapshot would be taken Nov 1 to show whether missing assets had been replaced.
records.methodology: Secondary reporting based on Binance reserve data and exchange statements.
records.limitations: The PoR file itself was not independently retrieved in this run; Nov 1 is a reported snapshot date, not proof it has been published.

records.title: Binance uncovers wider breach; targets Sunday withdrawal restart
records.summary: CoinDesk reports Binance planned an initial Proof of Reserves update before a full report on Monday Nov 2 and a Sunday withdrawal-restoration target.
records.methodology: Secondary report quoting Binance co-CEO Richard Teng.
records.limitations: Targets are not evidence of completed restoration or published PoR results.

records.title: Binance's hot wallets sent $6.3B to an attacker in under four hours; $2.7B frozen
records.summary: Bitquery's Oct 30 investigation reports 17 Binance-labelled hot wallets across nine chains, about $2.7B frozen and $3.2B still with the attacker at 06:43 UTC. Its XRPL receiver rK21t6...gfzMx held about 233.5M XRP and had not sent a transaction by that cutoff. Bitquery says XRP and Solana drains share no address with the other chain clusters; their linkage is timing, transaction construction and Binance's aggregate loss figure.
records.methodology: Provider-labelled wallet tracing, transaction histories and chain-state snapshot at 06:43 UTC Oct 30.
records.limitations: Snapshot is stale by more than a day at this run cutoff. Wallet labels are provider attribution, not a fresh official Binance address crosswalk. Bitquery's nine-chain scope differs from TRM's ten-chain scope.
